question: Devprayag is the place where the Bhagirathi joins ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alaknanda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Devprayag**

 
 
• Devprayag is **a town and a Nagar panchayat (municipality) in Tehri Garhwal district in the state of Uttarakhand, India.**
 
• **It is one of the Panch Prayag (five confluences) of the Alaknanda River where the Alaknanda and Bhagirathi rivers meet and take the name Ganga.**
 
• According to mythology, there is another river related to this confluence named Saraswati, which originates from Mana village of Badrinath.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ghaghara**

 
 
• **​**Ghaghara River is a tributary of** Ganga River**.
 
• This river originates in the Tibetan Plateau near** Lake Mansarovar**.
 
 
 
• **Gandak**
 
 
• Gandak River, also called **Narayani River**, river in central Nepal and northern India.
 
• It is formed by the union of the** Kali** and **Trisuli rivers**.
 
 
 
• **Meghna**
 
 
• **​**The combined flow of the Ganga (the Padma in Bangladesh), the **Barak river **and the Jamuna river are known as **Meghna **in** Bangladesh**.
